name: IRAS 10082-5647 (Hubble)
blurb: IRAS 10082-5647, a reflection nebula in Vela, seen by Hubble.
label: iras100825647-hubble
story: A cloud of gas and dust glows with light borrowed from a young Herbig Ae/Be star, a star so young it has not yet settled into the steady hydrogen burning of most of its life.

claims.text: IRAS 10082-5647 is in the constellation Vela
It is lit by a young Herbig Ae/Be star
The star has not yet reached the main sequence, where stars spend most of their lives fusing hydrogen
